mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market weakness (UNRATE > 8.0%) and manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) indicates broad economic stress that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% and INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (low unemployment and strong GDP growth), a rising unemployment rate signals an impending economic slowdown that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 450,000 units indicate robust consumer confidence and economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 450, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 450,000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 340,000 million dollars) indicates robust consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 450 and RSAFS > 340, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
